QuestInfo.name: Edelstein Stands Alone
QuestInfo.0: You can't hide your identity from the Edelstein citizens anymore. What to do...?
QuestInfo.1: Explore Edelstein, and look for someone, anyone, that doesn't hate you.
QuestInfo.2: #bUlrika#k talked to you! What could she want?

0.0: #b(10 Boogies was right. The citizens of Edelstein will never help the Cygnus Knights.)
0.1: #b(Which is too bad, because these guys seem really organized. Word traveled FAST about my identity.)
0.2: #b(I don't suppose anyone will talk to me now, but I can't give up. Perhaps if I wander around long enough, someone'll take pity on me.)

yes.0: There's got to be SOMEONE who will talk to me...

no.0: I guess I could use a break.

1.0: Hey, you! You're still here? Come here and talk to me for a second.\r\n#b(Ugh. Her again?)#k

yes.0: You're here to investigate the Black Wings. That's right, I know alllllll about it. How about we make a deal?

npc.0: Perhaps I should explore the town some more...
